KO.rationale: Coca-Cola is a high-quality defensive franchise with strong brand equity, an asset-light concentrate model, and dominant global market share (~43-46% global sparkling CSD). Q1 2026 results showed impressive 10% organic revenue growth, 8% volume growth, and operating margin expansion to 33.8%, with EPS of $0.86 beating consensus of $0.81. The business generates robust cash flow (projected $10.5B+ FCF in 2025) and maintains a 64-year dividend increase streak. However, the stock is currently trading at the top of its 1-year P/E range (28.5x vs 23.2-28.9 range), leaving limited valuation upside. The P/B of 11.5x is also near the top of its 9.4-11.7 range. While fundamentals are solid and trajectory is positive, the premium valuation caps the attractiveness. Rising 10-year Treasury yields (4.47%) and elevated oil prices ($104.66/bbl) create macro headwinds for a defensive name trading at peak multiples. No clear near-term re-rating catalyst beyond the already-reported Q1 beat. The score reflects a good business at a full price.

No clear near-term re-rating catalyst; Q1 beat already reported and digested
64 consecutive years of dividend increases with 2.6% yield provides income support
